last_synced: 2026-07-08 (Jira updated 14:31 — user_story reworded to drop 'behind live edge'; AC-01 adds tap-outside-dismiss (overlay incl. back/forward seek) + drops 'without an additional tap'; AC-03 adds 'ended/recorded state always takes priority over paused'; PM comment 68363: paused = play icon persists until tap-outside)
user_story: As a community member watching a live stream, I want to pause and resume the stream, so that I can step away and always rejoin at what is happening live.
user_story_note: Reworded by PM 2026-07-07 (Ghita, comment 68319): the 'behind live edge' wording was removed to match the ACs (pause + resume-to-current-live-moment). Story and ACs are now aligned. See ledger AMB-10.
preconditions: User is watching a live stream with Room status: live
entry_points: A. User deliberately pauses the live stream via the central pause button

not_supported: Desktop — no behaviour change; only a small UI design change (button size)

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Pause live stream → pause indicator (central play button) shown; chat keeps running live; tap-outside dismisses overlay but stays paused
given: The user pauses a live stream
then: A visual indicator is shown communicating the stream is paused
The chat continues to receive and display new messages in real time — it is not paused
Tapping anywhere outside the play button dismisses the overlay control (pause/play button only — a live stream has NO seek controls) — the live stream remains paused

clarifications_needed.observation: AC-01 requires 'a visual indicator communicating the stream is paused'. Figma LS-mobile-04-paused shows a central play (▶) button overlay and no separate badge/banner
clarifications_needed.consequence: Was unclear whether the pause indicator IS the central play-button overlay or a distinct element to design
clarifications_needed.question: Confirm the pause indicator = the central play-button overlay (LS-mobile-04), or is a distinct indicator required?
clarifications_needed.resolution: Confirmed the pause indicator = the central play-button overlay (Design, ledger AMB-09). Verified against products/PDT-3418/design/LS-mobile-04-paused.png — paused frame shows a central ▶ button and no separate badge. Design link shared in comment 68364.

clarifications_needed.observation: AC-01 stated the dismissable overlay control includes 'back and forward seeking' — but this is a LIVE stream, and UC3 AC-06 says seek/skip buttons are NOT shown on a live stream
clarifications_needed.consequence: Contradiction on whether a LIVE pause overlay shows seek controls; the wording was copied from the video overlay
clarifications_needed.question: On a LIVE stream pause overlay, should back/forward seeking controls appear at all? (Cross-ref UC1 AC-04 / OI-UC1-05.)
clarifications_needed.resolution: Decision 2026-07-08: a LIVE pause overlay has NO seek controls (seek is video/recorded only). AC-01 then[2] corrected to 'pause/play button only'. Jira AC-01 still carries the old wording → PM to align Jira (FU-5). See ledger CONF-08.

clarifications_needed.observation: Earlier concern (Chayanit Q1, 2026-07-06): the 'LIVE' badge kept showing while paused, which could mislead viewers
clarifications_needed.consequence: If the badge stays, viewers may not realise they are no longer at the current live moment
clarifications_needed.question: While paused, should the 'LIVE' badge be hidden or changed?
clarifications_needed.resolution: Jira 2026-07-06 (Ghita, PM): updating the LIVE badge on pause is a SEPARATE enhancement, OUT OF SCOPE for this release. Design (Phatcharanan 68350/68364): badge behaviour kept AS-IS (LIVE badge when 0 viewers, viewer count when >0).

clarifications_needed.observation: Earlier gap (Chayanit Q3, 2026-07-06): chat behaviour during pause was undefined; current behaviour differed by platform
clarifications_needed.consequence: Chat state during pause could not be asserted consistently
clarifications_needed.question: While a 'LIVE' stream is paused, should the chat stay current with the live moment?
clarifications_needed.resolution: AC-01/AC-02 now require chat to keep running live during pause and stay uninterrupted on resume. Prisa's platform table (68264) confirms chat keeps running live on iOS/Android/web during pause.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Resume from paused live stream → resumes from CURRENT LIVE MOMENT (not paused position); chat uninterrupted
given: The user resumes from a paused live stream
then: The stream starts from the current live moment — not from the previous paused position
The chat remains uninterrupted — no messages are missed or replayed

clarifications_needed.observation: AC-02 requires resume to return to the CURRENT LIVE MOMENT, but current behaviour on ALL platforms (platform table 68264) is resume-FROM-PAUSED-POSITION (iOS, Android, web-desktop all ✅)
clarifications_needed.consequence: AC-02 is a behaviour CHANGE from today's product, not a description of existing behaviour — dev must actively change resume on every supported platform, and QA must test the NEW behaviour
clarifications_needed.question: Confirm resume-to-live-moment is the intended NEW behaviour on all supported platforms (replacing today's resume-from-pause)? Platform exceptions?
clarifications_needed.resolution: Confirmed as the new behaviour on all platforms (Jira 2026-07-07): PM 68319 'stream starts from the current live moment, not the previous paused position'; iOS Prisa 68306 and Android Fidriyanto 68316 both confirm resume can jump to the live moment. TEST TOLERANCE: it lands very close to live but a few seconds behind, due to normal live-stream buffering — 'expected'. This is a behaviour CHANGE vs current product (must be implemented + tested anew). See ledger CONF-07.

clarifications_needed.observation: Earlier open item: is a 'return to live' CTA in scope (viewer stuck behind live edge)?
clarifications_needed.consequence: If in scope, AC needed an extra CTA test + design
clarifications_needed.question: Is a 'return to live' CTA in scope for PDT-3418, or a follow-on?
clarifications_needed.resolution: Moot after the AC-02 rewrite: resume now returns to the current live moment, so there is no lingering 'behind live' state to return from. No return-to-live CTA needed this release.

clarifications_needed.observation: Earlier (Prisa / iOS): a rolling rewind buffer meant a long pause could not resume from the exact paused position
clarifications_needed.consequence: The old AC-02 ('resume from paused position') did not hold once the pause exceeded the buffer
clarifications_needed.question: What is the buffer duration and behaviour when exceeded?
clarifications_needed.resolution: Superseded by the AC-02 rewrite: resume now returns to the current live moment (not the paused position). Note (Fidriyanto 68317): backward seek during live is limited to a certain duration (exact limit TBD) — relevant to seek, not to this resume AC.

acceptance_criteria.group: Stream ends while viewer is paused
acceptance_criteria.scenario: Stream ends during pause → player moves to ended/recorded state (takes priority over pause), no frozen frame
given: The user has paused a live stream
acceptance_criteria.when: The Room transitions to ended or recorded during the pause
then: The player moves to an appropriate ended or recorded state
The ended or recorded state always takes priority over the paused state
The viewer is not left on a frozen frame with no feedback

clarifications_needed.observation: Jira comments (Fidriyanto/Android, Prisa/iOS) confirm: when the host ends the stream while the viewer is paused, the stream stops and the ended state is shown — not a frozen frame
clarifications_needed.consequence: AC-03 is validated against current Android/iOS behaviour
clarifications_needed.question: Confirm AC-03 matches current Android/iOS behaviour?
clarifications_needed.resolution: Confirmed on Android and iOS (platform table 68264): host-ends-during-pause moves the player to the ended state, no frozen frame.

clarifications_needed.observation: No AC covered tapping pause at the exact instant the host ends the stream (race condition)
clarifications_needed.consequence: The player could land in an inconsistent paused+ended state → stuck UI
clarifications_needed.question: If pause and stream-end happen simultaneously, which state wins — ended/recorded or paused?
clarifications_needed.resolution: Ended/recorded ALWAYS wins, even if both occur simultaneously (PM 68319; iOS Prisa 68306; Android Fidriyanto 68316). Now encoded in AC-03 then[2]. See ledger GAP-05.

clarifications_needed.observation: AC-03 moves to an ended/recorded state but did not cover the stream having ended while the recording is still processing
clarifications_needed.consequence: The viewer might see a frozen frame or error while the recording is not yet ready
clarifications_needed.question: If the stream ends while paused but the recording isn't ready, show an intermediate 'processing' state?
clarifications_needed.resolution: No separate 'processing' state and no frozen frame — the player shows 'Livestream ended' (iOS Prisa 68306; Android Fidriyanto 68316: shows 'Livestream ended' like the non-paused case). See ledger GAP-06.
